title: Hammer and Floatie
text: “So this Risuka thing has proper cheek pouches, huh.”
“Guess so. Wonder if it stuffs several nuts in there at once? Might even be some kind of gimmick tied to that somewhere.”
“Please don’t bring up unpleasant topics like that.”
“Fear not, Itsuki, I say!”
I gave Itsuki a thumbs up.
“If anything’s going to turn out shady in a hypothetical scenario, it’s your accuracy, indeed.”
“Well, that’s one point scored against you, Itsuki.”
“Yeah. No question you shouldn’t run your mouth so carelessly.”
“Ugh, seriously. Are you people incapable of feeling satisfied unless you say something uncalled for?”
I really didn’t want to hear that from Itsuki of all people.

“Well, if I bring someone along to fight in the water, mobility should be fine, don’t you think? Motoyasu-kun could use a harpoon-type spear, and Itsuki could attack with something like an underwater gun—that ought to be effective.”

“I think the real issue is how long we can stay submerged. No matter how much Naofumi-san can carry us through the water… if the battle takes place somewhere without a water’s surface, that’s going to be rough. It’d help if we could just breathe down there.”
At that, all our eyes turned toward Itsuki’s cheek pouches.
“My cheek pouches are not oxygen tanks! And even if they were, how exactly do you all plan to receive oxygen from me?!”
Wouldn’t that literally mean mouth-to-mouth? Though I’d rather be spared the experience of kissing Itsuki, thank you very much.
“If Ren ever starts drowning, it seems best he gets some oxygen from Itsuki, indeed.”
Father would never drown, of course. So really, it was just a matter of being careful.
“I am absolutely not going into the water!”
“Same here! I’ll think about it if it ever actually becomes necessary!”

“Ahaha… Let’s just hope there’s no underwater stage, honestly. Though if we had a weapon that let us dive underwater, that’d solve it. Like, if I could put up some kind of bubble barrier, I could just carry everyone along regardless of whether they can swim.”
“That would be nice, but… given my current condition, that sounds difficult.”
In Itsuki’s case, it seemed his cheek pouches swelled up due to some trait belonging to his nature as a Risuka.
“So it comes down to me luring the boss around while everyone else attacks, I suppose.”

“That’s probably the safest gimmick to plan around, Ren-san. Since Naofumi-san will pull you back up before you drown, just in case, try diving in using water magic or whatever else you can manage to breathe with.”
“No.”
“Why are you so set against swimming that you’d go this far… This must be what they mean by ‘bone-deep hammer.’”
Indeed, Ren truly was a hammer through and through. Except—
“Didn’t Ren seem to be able to swim once peace came to the first world?”
His build had grown considerably by then. Incidentally, even before becoming Inuruto, Ren had gradually started growing taller too.
“Did he actually overcome his hammer problem?”
“In more ways than one, it seems Ren-san has grown the most while speaking with his back turned on us, so to speak.”
“Motoyasu, don’t say anything unnecessary…”
“Anyway, why can’t Ren swim in the first place? Does he have some kind of trauma?”
At our question, Ren looked away and fell silent.
“Itsuki, now’s your chance—unleash your uncanny accuracy and nail it, I say.”
“Please don’t expect my accuracy to solve everything. If I had to guess, it’s probably something like nearly drowning after being dragged along swimming by a childhood friend.”
“Ah… that does seem plausible,” Father said, nodding.
Ren was practically fighting to maintain his silence. Whether that meant we’d hit the mark, I honestly couldn’t say.
“Come to think of it, people call logging into the net ‘diving,’ don’t they?”

“I see, in a sense, existing as an avatar online could also be considered a form of swimming, couldn’t it? Perhaps you got so used to how things worked online that when you actually entered water, you tried breathing the same way and ended up nearly drowning as a result?”
Ren clenched his fist ever so slightly. Somehow, I could tell we’d hit the mark.
“Fine, let’s just go already!”
“In other words, an underwater experiment, I take it.”
“That is NOT what I meant!”
“Well, it’s become pretty clear that it’s not just one reason Ren can’t swim—more like several stacking up together. Itsuki’s accuracy seems to have hit the mark nicely.”
“I said that’s not it!”
“If you can breathe, you won’t drown, right? So let’s test that with some magic. Sound good?”
“Indeed, it does seem like Ren was fine as long as he could breathe, right up until the drowning part, I say.”
Back in the first world, once everyone besides Ren could breathe underwater using water magic or wind magic, the panic had stopped entirely.
“We’ve got convenient magic at our disposal, after all. Water magic might just do the trick.”
And so, Ren used magic to form a bubble membrane around his face.
“Here, hop on my back properly.”
“Naofumi! Don’t you dare let go!”
“Yeah, yeah, I know.”
Ren climbed tightly onto Naofumi’s back, gripping his shoulders.
“Alright, we’re diving down a little now.”

With that, Naofumi carried Ren straight down into the water. Watching from the surface, once Ren was underwater, he clung on so tightly to Naofumi’s back that he showed no sign of ever letting go. Still, being latched onto Naofumi’s back meant his mobility was more than sufficient. Perhaps having grown used to the water, Ren tried an experiment—getting off Naofumi’s back to walk underwater—but just like me, his movements turned sluggish. What’s more, bubbles began erupting from his mouth as his concentration apparently broke, and the bubble around his face started dissipating. Naofumi hurried to bring Ren back up to the surface.
“Looks like Ren can use magic to breathe just fine, but he gets the same movement restrictions underwater as Motoyasu-kun.”
“Even from the surface, I could tell Ren-san’s concentration slipped. Is it impossible unless he’s stuck to Naofumi-san?”
“Shut up.”
“Since Motoyasu-kun can’t use water magic to breathe, if we ever need to fight underwater, I guess we’ll have to ask Ren.”
“I can just use bubble magic from the surface so Motoyasu can breathe, that’ll be fine.”
“As long as it’s within a range Ren can keep monitoring…”
“Actually, if we’re talking mobility, shouldn’t it be Itsuki riding on Naofumi’s back? Just use the bubble magic on his face and he should be fine.”
At Ren’s suggestion, Itsuki’s brow furrowed.
“So you intend to drag me into this too. By that logic, since I’m neither a ranged skill user nor exactly close combat, all I need to do is focus on controlling my floating swords, Ren-san.”
Itsuki fired right back without missing a beat.
“Well… honestly, the scariest part would be needing to juggle multiple gimmicks at once. Like if wherever I end up requires wall-climbing on top of everything else.”
“That does sound like the kind of gimmick you’d find in an action game… but, fine. I suppose it’s my turn now, Ren-san.”
“Heh… leave it to me.”
Ren answered with a confident, fearless smirk. None of us had forgotten how he’d nearly drowned in a panic just moments earlier, though.
“I can already picture it—the bubble popping the second he’s underwater, and Itsuki’s cheek pouches swelling up to send him floating right back to the surface.”
“Ren-san. I know you think you’re holding my lifeline, but if that happens, the moment I get out of the water, I am shoving you right back in!”
“Tch!”

Seemed we’d hit the mark. Payback for all the teasing, perhaps? Now it was Itsuki’s turn—his face wrapped in a bubble courtesy of Ren’s magic, he tried diving alongside Naofumi. But the moment the water reached his chest, his cheek pouches started swelling up.
“Looks like once more than half his body’s submerged, the cheek pouches start puffing up.”
“Y-yeah, seems that way. Ugh… it’s hard to dive like this, and hard to aim a gun too.”
“……Guess there was no need to go and tease you after all.”
“Oh, shut it! Given the combinations available, Ren-san, if you ever need to fight, going with Naofumi-san is the safest choice, you see!”
“Ugh… I can only hope that no such situation arises!”
I must admit, I am rather envious of that combination with Father.
“Even until the bubble's effect wears off, I suppose I should be fine, I say.”
“Is Motoyasu unusually thinking of me for once?”
“No, that's just the thought of wanting to fight together with Naofumi-san. The optimal solution is Ren.”
Itsuki, do not keep saying that over and over, I say.
“Would poking Itsuki's cheek pouches underwater make them pull back, I wonder?”

“When I tried it as an experiment earlier, the air just went deeper inside Itsuki's body and didn't come out. Once Itsuki finally breathed it all out properly, he ended up inhaling a whole bunch right back underwater.”
“I am a stone in water, but Itsuki is like a flotation ring, that is.”
“Who asked you to say something clever!”
